title: Infini-Transeon Runtime Protocol v1
encoding: binary envelope; UTF-8 only for text-bearing payload fields explicitly defined by a message contract
framing: signed little-endian 32-bit body-length prefix validated as positive before allocation

bootstrapTransport.framing: unsigned little-endian 32-bit payload-length prefix with a 512-byte hard ceiling

handshakeResponse.capabilitiesValidation: protocol version and every fixed v1 safety ceiling must match before admission

flowContracts.allocation: validate length and shared budget before allocation; binary buffers are receiver-freed after processing
flowContracts.ordering: runtime epoch then source/channel/stage token then strictly increasing cumulative sequence

postHandshake.ownership: one receive loop multiplexes correlated responses and bounded events; writes are serialized
postHandshake.overlayAcknowledgement: returned only after the native overlay owner thread applies or explicitly rejects the complete revision
postHandshake.policyAcknowledgement: returned only after profile identity validation and atomic replacement of every matching target policy, including an empty baseline snapshot
postHandshake.processingConfigurationAcknowledgement: returned after target existence, profile identity, revision ordering, capacity and scheduling fields are validated and atomically stored
postHandshake.ocrResultAcknowledgement: returned after embedded runtime identity, target, profile, area and monotonic source/result generations are validated
postHandshake.unsupportedMessageBehavior: explicit protocol failure and connection termination

backpressure.rejection: immediate explicit failure without waiting or silent dropping

reconnect: full state snapshot; never replay text or provider completions
